words.prose: {{ar:نَادَيْتُمْ}} ({{tr:nādaytum}}) is the first finite action, so the believers' public call defines the scene before the mockers act. The root-family assembly and generosity pressures make the call feel like a gathering summons and an outward invitation, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as public calling. The coda {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) {{ar:يَعْقِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿqilūn}}) shows that the call becomes a test of comprehension, with 2:171 sharpening the call-without-understanding pattern.

Root-family pressures of turning, bending, following, connection, and blessing make the target weighty, while local grammar keeps the sense as the known prayer. The assimilated article and conventional prayer spelling make the known institution visibly and audibly marked. Same-surah links to covenantal prayer and true allegiance (5:12; 5:55), plus the approach-to-prayer frame in 5:6 and the later obstruction of prayer in 5:91, make the inversion sharper.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّخَذُوهَا}} ({{tr:ittakhadhūhā}}) is the ayah's conversion engine. The hidden third-person plural subject keeps the mockers recoverable, while {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:-hā}}) routes the act back to the prayer or its call event. The perfect response after the recurring condition exposes a settled hostile posture each time the call occurs. Form VIII makes the action self-involving: they appropriate it for themselves as {{ar:هُزُوًۭا}} ({{tr:huzuwan}}) and {{ar:لَعِبًۭا}} ({{tr:laʿiban}}), turning possible reception into hostile taking. words.prose: {{ar:هُزُوًۭا}} ({{tr:huzuwan}}) is the first named result after the object suffix in {{ar:ٱتَّخَذُوهَا}} ({{tr:ittakhadhūhā}}). Its indefinite accusative shape pairs with {{ar:لَعِبًۭا}} ({{tr:laʿiban}}), so the prayer-call is converted into a single ridicule-play mode. The root pressure strips gravity from prayer, and the word's repetition from 5:57 makes the scene the enacted example of the prior warning. Qiraat variation around hamza can harden the word with glottal arrest, soften it, or contract it in pause, while the complement role remains stable. Its indefinite -an cadence also begins the sound thread that runs through {{ar:لَعِبًۭا}} ({{tr:laʿiban}}) and lands later on {{ar:قَوْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:qawmun}}).

words.prose: {{ar:لَعِبًۭا}} ({{tr:laʿiban}}) completes the paired result. It mirrors {{ar:هُزُوًۭا}} ({{tr:huzuwan}}) as an indefinite accusative, so the prayer-call is converted into one ridicule-play mode, not two unrelated outcomes. The purposeless-action field matters because the phrase has just moved toward the directed goal of {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣalāti}}). Root-family pressure adds uncontrolled overflow and manipulative handling, while local grammar keeps the word as the play complement. words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) compresses the whole call-and-mockery event into a single referent for diagnosis. Its masculine singular form resists a narrow return only to the feminine {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣalāti}}), and its distal force holds the behavior at evaluative distance. It points backward to {{ar:ٱتَّخَذُوهَا}} ({{tr:ittakhadhūhā}}) with its paired complements and forward to {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:annahum}}), shifting the ayah from event to cause. Within Surah 5, the same demonstrative profile belongs to verdict and explanation transitions, so this pointer feels like a judgment marker, not a bare pronoun.

words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:qawmun}}) is the predicate of {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:annahum}}), so the coda identifies a type of people rather than only one behavior. The phrase also activates the familiar collective-reason formula, localized here to the people who turn the prayer-call into mockery. Its nominative -un cadence answers the earlier -an endings of {{ar:هُزُوًۭا}} ({{tr:huzuwan}}) and {{ar:لَعِبًۭا}} ({{tr:laʿiban}}), tying the object-state pair to the people who embody it. words.prose: {{ar:يَعْقِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿqilūn}}) is the final landing word, so the ayah ends not on mockery but on the faculty whose absence explains it. Under {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}), the imperfect describes a continuing condition, not a command or one past failure, and the lack of an explicit object generalizes the failure of reason as a faculty. The root's binding image matters: they fail to bind the public call to prayer into coherent, accountable understanding. The plural -ūn ending distributes that failure across the collective behind {{ar:قَوْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:qawmun}}) and gives the close a group-verdict cadence. Parallels with 2:171, 6:32, and the later same-surah return at 5:103 show the verdict as part of a wider failed-comprehension pattern.

topics.headline: ongoing diagnosis, not command

topics.reason: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is negative, not prohibitive, so the imperfect remains descriptive inside the modifier clause.

topics.headline: failure is generalized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no explicit object narrows the failure; the ayah denies exercise of reason itself.
topics.reason: The verb appears without a stated object and in basic Form I.

topics.headline: reason binds perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reason as binding and restraint: the mockers cannot bind call, perception, and response into understanding.
topics.reason: Binding and restraint imagery is retained as root pressure; literal hobbling or compensation is not the local sense.

topics.headline: plural ending distributes failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure belongs to the collective behind {{ar:قَوْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:qawmun}}).
topics.reason: The plural ending agrees with the collective subject sense and closes with plural cadence.

topics.headline: final reason answers whole scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word explains the prayer-call mockery through a wider call, play, and reason-failure pattern (2:171; 6:32; 5:103).
topics.reason: Concrete parallels connect calling, play, collective diagnosis, and same-surah recurrence of the formula.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence نَادَيْتُمْ ... ٱتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا ... لَا يَعْقِلُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: An audible summons to a purpose-bound worship is actively taken and remade as two purpose-defeating modes, derision and play. The closing عقل diagnosis names failure to restrain that recoding and hold the heard signal to its proper end.

activation_trace.role: Raised voice and calling supply the public signal that reaches the hearers.
The prescribed worship supplies the call's serious and ordered end.
Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies deliberate conversion rather than passive amusement.
Derision supplies the first socially degrading replacement use.
Action without a sound purpose supplies the second replacement and exposes the loss of telos.
Intellect as a restraint from ignorance supplies the missing check on the recoding.

changed_reading.before: They happen to laugh when the prayer call is heard.
changed_reading.after: They deliberately appropriate a public summons and convert its ordered purpose into a degrading, purposeless social performance because judgment does not restrain the conversion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked terms نَادَيْتُمْ, ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ, قَوْمٌ, and يَعْقِلُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call is also an assembling act, and prayer is an obligatory practice that should turn gathered persons into a coordinated standing body. The verse calls the mockers a قوم while depicting a group that will not tether itself to the shared act; play is therefore a counter-assembly, togetherness without governing purpose.

activation_trace.role: Assembly in a club or council makes the call an act of gathering as well as sounding.
Obligatory worship supplies the common practice meant to organize those gathered.
A human group supplies the corporate subject rather than an isolated scoffer.
Bodily standing supplies the unrealized coordination latent in the label قوم.
Hobbling an animal supplies the binding image for keeping collective motion under a shared rule.
Purposeless play supplies a rival mode of gathering that never becomes ordered action.

changed_reading.before: A group of people lacks abstract understanding.
changed_reading.after: A summons that should assemble and coordinate a standing community instead produces a counter-assembly whose members remain socially untethered to the practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding verse applies the same taking-mockery-play construction to religion, places it beside alliance, and the following verse names belief and received revelation as the grievance. The prayer call is thus the audible public badge of an obedience and affiliation that ridicule tries to make socially costly.

activation_trace.role: The raised public call supplies an affiliation marker that cannot remain private.
The prescribed worship supplies the publicly marked practice.
Repeated taking as making or acquisition shows deliberate recoding already applied to the religion.
Obedience and submission supply the allegiance whose visible practice is being degraded.
The exact derision term carries the degrading operation directly into the focus.
The exact purposeless-play term confirms a repeated recoding pattern rather than a one-off reaction.
Love, support, and alliance supply the social boundary within which ridicule operates.
Disapproving and faulting supplies the aversion directed at the community's belief.

The alliance prohibition in 5:57 and the grievance question in 5:59 enclose the focus in a social-affiliation frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical repetition, obedience, alliance, and aversion to belief; I infer that ridicule polices affiliation by lowering the public status of the prayer call. A live alternative is diffuse contempt with no strategic boundary-policing function.

changed_reading.before: The prayer call is mocked as an isolated ritual sound.
changed_reading.after: The call is mocked because it audibly declares an obedience and communal alignment; turning it into play is a way to police who may inhabit that alignment without social cost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence moves from rushing into harmful action to failed restraint by learned authorities and finally to a community that does not restrain one another. Against قوم and عقل in the focus, non-reason becomes a failed inhibitory system distributed across persons, leaders, and peers.

activation_trace.role: The human group supplies the corporate scale at which restraint should operate.
Reason as a restraint from ugliness supplies the missing inhibitory function.
Speed opposed to delay supplies the uncontrolled acceleration that needs a brake.
The intellect that restrains ugliness supplies an explicit contextual analogue to عقل and assigns it to leadership.
Checking and deterring action supplies the peer-to-peer brake the group fails to apply.
A reprehensible act that should be repelled supplies the object of the absent communal check.

structural_cues: 5:62 describes acceleration into wrongdoing; 5:63 asks why named authorities do not restrain it.
5:79 changes the missing restraint from an elite duty into reciprocal communal non-restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceleration, named restrainers, and reciprocal failure to check wrong; I infer a distributed social control loop and read عقل as its inner binding component. The live alternative is a list of separate moral failures rather than one inhibitory mechanism.

changed_reading.before: لَا يَعْقِلُونَ reports a private cognitive deficiency.
changed_reading.after: لَا يَعْقِلُونَ diagnoses a group whose inner judgment, learned leadership, and peer correction all fail to slow and bind conduct, allowing the call itself to be socially recoded.

context_deltas.mechanism: A binding reversal appears after the focus: the group that will not exercise عقل as self-restraint attributes a fetter to the divine hand, while the response declares that hand extended. Repeated إقامة of received texts then supplies the positive alternative, taking up and standing an order rather than relocating restraint onto its giver.

activation_trace.role: The hobble that binds an animal supplies the self-binding capacity denied in the focus.
Rising with resolve to an undertaking supplies the positive action latent in قوم.
A collar or fetter binding a limb supplies the restraint wrongly located on the divine hand.
Extending and releasing the hand supplies the explicit reversal of the alleged fetter.
Rising to an undertaking supplies إقامة as the act of taking up the received order.
Straightness and rectitude sharpen the repeated demand to establish the received texts and contrast it with the group's condition.

structural_cues: 5:64 places bound hands and extended hands in direct grammatical reversal.
5:66 and 5:68 repeat إقامة of received texts, while the focus joins قوم to failure of عقل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal fettering and extension, the عقل binding image, and repeated إقامة; I infer a projection in which refused self-binding is attributed to the giver and then answered by a demand for upright enactment. A live alternative is that the hand polemic and the focus's cognition are adjacent but independent.

changed_reading.before: The mockers simply fail to comprehend the prayer call.
changed_reading.after: They invert the location of restraint: unwilling to bind themselves into upright practice, they turn the call into play and imagine constraint in the divine source of giving.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context repeatedly maps reception failure as routing by desire: unwanted messenger-content meets denial, deafness recurs, clarified signs are turned from their direction, and inherited desires are followed. The focus's اتخاذ is therefore an active redirect of a signal that has arrived, not a mere failure of acoustic access.

activation_trace.role: The raised and far-reaching sound supplies a signal capable of physically reaching its audience.
Deliberate making or acquisition supplies the audience's active reassignment of the signal.
Discriminating restraint supplies the faculty that should prevent desire from controlling the route.
The soul's inclination supplies the preference filter rejecting unwelcome messenger-content.
Repeated loss of hearing and refusal to listen supply a recurrent closure after the signal arrives.
Turning a thing away from its direction supplies the rerouting operation after signs are made clear.
Following behind supplies the chosen path by which inherited desire governs response.
The repeated inclination of desire confirms that the routing pressure is appetitive rather than acoustic.

structural_cues: 5:70 gives the sequence messenger arrival, conflict with desire, then denial or killing.
5:71 repeats blindness and deafness; 5:75 places clear exposition before being turned; 5:77 explicitly joins following desire to loss of the straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, desire, recurrent deafness, turning, and following; I infer a directional chain in which desire diverts received content into mockery and play. A live alternative is that these are distinct refusals with no single reception pipeline.

changed_reading.before: The audience mocks because it cannot understand what it hears.
changed_reading.after: The sound reaches the audience, but desire controls its routing: deliberate recoding turns a demanding summons into play before discriminating restraint can bind hearing to response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later receptive scene supplies a positive control for the focus. Delivery reaches its endpoint; hearing becomes understanding, bodily overflow, recognition, spoken assent, registration, and witnessed belonging. The focus shows the same signal-to-body-to-group chain broken at the conversion from hearing to meaningful response.

activation_trace.role: The range and reach of a raised voice supply the initiating signal.
Understanding that restrains error supplies the missing conversion from reception to commitment.
Delivering a message supplies the upstream relay that is meant to reach hearers.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies successful uptake rather than bare audition.
Easy abundant overflow supplies the bodily consequence of successful reception.
Recognition by an identifying trace supplies the discriminating act absent from mockery.
Entering a name in a register or company supplies durable social incorporation after assent.
Presence with witnessing supplies the communal endpoint of the completed reception chain.

structural_cues: 5:83 unfolds a continuous sequence from hearing to eyes, tears, recognition, speech, inscription, and witnesses.
The focus also begins with an audible event and ends with a group diagnosis, but inserts mockery and play where 5:83 supplies recognition and incorporation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies message delivery and the full later hearing-to-membership cascade; I infer that this later scene functions as a positive control for what عقل-mediated reception could have done in the focus. A live alternative is that hearing revelation and hearing the prayer call are parallel but not intended as one reception model.

changed_reading.before: Mockery is simply the opposite of taking the prayer call seriously.
changed_reading.after: Mockery is a broken reception chain: sound becomes spectacle instead of understanding, embodied recognition, confession, and incorporation into a witnessing community.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the form-distant ن و د mapping of the call root and the peripheral mount-moving branch of ه ز ء. It remains anchored to نَادَيْتُمْ, هُزُوًا, لَعِبًا, قَوْمٌ, and يَعْقِلُونَ as a coherent motion-versus-binding mechanism. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory possibility that ridicule may include bodily or performative capture, never as the lexical meaning of the sentence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The motion-bearing split of نَادَيْتُمْ beside هُزُوًا, لَعِبًا, قَوْمٌ, and the hobbling image of يَعْقِلُونَ.

activation_trace.role: Swaying and movement supply a non-dominant kinetic activation within the call root's split mapping.
Moving a mount supplies a second kinetic image for converting semantic summons into motion.
Purposeless action supplies the performative mode into which the call is captured.
Bodily standing supplies the ordered movement that the prayer call seeks.
Hobbling supplies the absent tether that would discipline motion toward the call's end.

changed_reading.before: Mockery is only a verbal comment on the call.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the hearers capture a summons meant to coordinate standing bodies and discharge it as untethered performative motion or play.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates peripheral thermal branches rather than ordinary lexical senses. It remains anchored to ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ, هُزُوًا, and لَعِبًا, while 5:64 supplies an explicit ignition-extinguishing sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for neutralizing the call's demanding force, not claim that prayer, mockery, or play literally denote temperatures here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heat branch of ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ, the severe-cold branch of هُزُوًا, and the heat-shimmer branch of لَعِبًا.

activation_trace.role: Meeting fire and its heat supplies the demanding intensity from which the thermal analogy begins.
Severe cold that strikes supplies a numbing replacement for the call's heat.
Heat threads or mirage supply visual dissipation without a stable object or end.
Igniting fire supplies a contextual cycle of generated intensity.
The flame's subsiding and ember's cooling supply the contextual act of neutralizing intensity.

changed_reading.before: Mockery and play merely lower the prayer call's seriousness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they thermally neutralize it: the encounter's heat is answered by numbing cold and mirage-like dissipation, an extinguishing of practical force.

strongest_changes: The exact 5:57 repetition and 5:59 grievance frame turn ridicule from casual amusement into public recoding of an affiliation marker.
The restraint sequence in 5:62-63 and 5:79 turns لَا يَعْقِلُونَ from generic incomprehension into failure of personal, institutional, and reciprocal inhibition.
The desire, deafness, and turning sequence makes mockery an active rerouting of a signal that has reached its audience.
The 5:83 hearing-to-witnessing cascade supplies a positive control: meaningful reception should become recognition, embodied response, assent, and communal incorporation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus combines making, gathering, standing, and binding roots, so context activates a social-control and signal-routing diagnosis rather than a flat claim about intelligence. The bound-hand reversal and the contained kinetic and thermal branches preserve stranger material readings without displacing the stronger mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supports a boundary-policing effect, but it does not settle whether the ridicule is strategically coordinated or simply has that social consequence.
The projected-binding model may reflect a real reversal across 5:58-68 or only a productive adjacency of restraint images.
The kinetic and thermal outliers depend on form-distant or peripheral branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The public call is answered by failure to tether action.** `ن د و B002` is raised calling, `ع ق ل B001` understanding as restraint, and `B002` tethering with a hobble. Mocking play (`ل ع ب B001`) lets response wander without aim. I infer that “not understanding” is practical untetheredness, not lack of auditory reception.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Mockery intercepts a public coordination signal.** Fixed **ن د و / B002** (“raised voice and calling”) supplies the acoustic action, while **B001** (“gathering in a council”) activates the call’s social aim. 5:55–5:56 connected prayer with a gathered party; 5:57 named purposeless play, and 5:59–5:60 expose resentment behind the response. I infer that ridiculing the call disrupts its passage from sound to assembly. The episode reads as sabotage of communal synchronization, not only derision of a melody.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:59 exposed belief itself as the grievance beneath the mockery, confirming that ridicule of the call was resistance to the community it coordinates.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النادي والندى والندوة والمنتدى بمعنى مجلس القوم ومتحدثهم ومكان اجتماعهم، ويدخل فيه الجلوس والمشاورة وحضور الندي، ويدخل فيه أهل النادي أو العشيرة إذا سمي المكان بهم.

branches.branch_image_ar: تندية الإبل والخيل بين الماء والمرعى
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ندوة الإبل والتندية في الإبل والخيل، بأن ترد الماء ثم ترعى ساعة أو تنتقل من المشرب إلى المرعى القريب أو من الحمض إلى الخلة ثم تعود، ويدخل فيه موضع الشرب القريب والأكلة بين الشربتين.
يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى البلل والرطوبة والمطر والطل، وندى الشيء إذا ابتل، والأرض أو اليوم أو الليلة الندية.
يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الكلأ أو النبت، والشجر المسمى ندى لكونه من الندى.
يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الشحم، وخاصة حين يفسر بأنه يكون عن ندى النبت.
يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الجود والعطاء والمعروف والخير، وندي الكف، وأندى الرجل أو تندى إذا تسخى أو كثر عطاؤه.
يدخل فيه ما نديت بشيء تكرهه أو بشر، وما نديت كفي، ويتند من الدم الحرام، والمنديات أو منديات الكلم بمعنى المخزيات.

branches.branch_image_ar: نزوع في النسب إلى أصل كريم
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قولهم تندو الناقة إلى نوق كرام أي تنزع إليها في النسب.
يدخل فيه نادى بمعنى ظهر، وناديته بمعنى علمته، وهذا الطريق يناديك، وما ظهر ظهور صوت المنادي.
يدخل فيه نوادي الكلام أي ما يخرج وقتا بعد وقت، والنوادي بمعنى النواحي أو القواصي، وندا فلان إذا اعتزل وتنحى، والناديات من النخيل البعيدة من الماء.
يدخل فيه ما ذكره ابن فارس عند الهمز من دلالة على طرائق وآثار، مثل الندأة في الشحم أو قوس قزح أو الحمرة في الغيم، وندء اللحم في الملة حتى ينضج.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın çekimli biçimler insanın sallanıp hareket etmesini anlatır; dal ve okul kullanımları yalnız belirtilen yapılara bağlı tutulur.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeni bir yandan öbür yana sallanarak hareket eder.
Dalın hareket edip sallanması, anlam çekirdeğinin belirtilen yapıya bağlı cansız varlık uygulamasıdır.
Yahudilerin okullarındaki beden sallama hareketi, aynı hareket çekirdeğinden türetilen yapıya bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak, insanın sallanıp hareket etmesini temel anlam olarak sunar; dalın hareket edip sallanmasını ve Yahudilerin okullarındaki beden salınımını da bu hareket anlamından türeyen kullanımlar olarak birlikte kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: bir yandan öbür yana sallanarak hareket etme

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi kendisi için edinmek veya kendine ait hale getirmek; mal ya da yapılan iş karşılığında ücret kazanmak anlamlarını taşıyan türemiş kullanımlar kümesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel alay çekirdeğini yalın biçimlerden; birini alay ve oyun konusu yapma anlamını ise yalnız tanıklı yapısından ayrı tutar.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

source_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

tier_contracts.explicit_interest: Full source branch payload, except fields removed from all tiers.
tier_contracts.local_low_branch_safety: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status, branch_kind, and reviewed/dictionary concept/context gloss text.
tier_contracts.compact_rest: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status; a semantic fallback is added only when both Arabic fields are empty.

branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
